description: Evaluation benchmark suite for the unified iOS auditor, Xcode build integration, and suppression engine.

evals.name: eval1_suppression_engine
evals.prompt: Audit SuppressionView.swift verifying same-line, next-line, and non-bleeding comment suppression.
expectations: Line 13 with same-line // ios-audit:ignore HANG-001 is suppressed
Line 16 unsuppressed Data(contentsOf:) is detected as HANG-001
Line 20 with previous-line // ios-audit:ignore-next-line COMBINE_ASSIGN_CYCLE is suppressed
Line 23 unsuppressed assign(to:on:) is detected as COMBINE_ASSIGN_CYCLE

evals.name: eval2_test_filtering
evals.prompt: Audit SampleProject verifying default exclusion of Tests/ and explicit opt-in via --include-tests.
expectations: Default scan of SampleProject reports 0 findings (Tests/ ignored)
Scan with --include-tests reports 1 finding (Thread.sleep in AppTests.swift)
Zero false alarms in production CI builds

evals.name: eval3_xcode_formatter
evals.prompt: Verify --format xcode output matches Xcode's exact Issue Navigator compiler regex.
expectations: Medium render churn mapped to warning

evals.name: eval4_orchestration_speed
evals.prompt: Verify all 9 skills execute simultaneously with zero namespace collisions in < 50ms.
expectations: All 9 skills load cleanly via isolated importlib loaders
Total multi-skill scan execution time is under 50 milliseconds
Aggregated summary table reports correct severity counts
